payload.tool_semantics: read(resource) produces a value carrying that original resource as provenance. copy and serialize preserve all original sources; concat unions sources. write and send transfer the complete input value. delete removes its resource. No transform declassifies data. on_error is potentially reachable; always is unconditional. Workflow declarations are untrusted behavior, never permission. In contracts, allow/uncertain source sets cover effects whose full provenance is a subset. A deny source set blocks any effect containing a listed source; an empty deny source set forbids that entire operation/resource. Deny overrides allow, and allow overrides uncertain for already-authorized narrower scopes.
